metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: Like Community and Scrubs, this features a lovable ensemble cast in a workplace setting with a very heart-warming core.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: A high-energy workplace comedy with a diverse cast and sharp writing that matches the pacing of New Girl.

metas.name: 30 Rock
metas.description: Features fast-paced, meta-humor and industry satire that fans of Community and Silicon Valley will appreciate.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: An uplifting and hilarious 'fish out of water' story that offers the same emotional payoff as Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Arrested Development
metas.description: An incredibly smart, layered sitcom with a dysfunctional family dynamic similar to It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia.

metas.name: Archer
metas.description: An adult animated comedy with snarky, high-concept humor that aligns perfectly with Rick and Morty and Futurama.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: A quintessential comfort show about a quirky but loving family, making it a great follow-up to King of the Hill.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: An absurdist mockumentary about vampires that captures the dark, dry wit found in Peep Show.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: A legendary British sitcom focusing on nerd culture and social awkwardness, much like Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Taskmaster
metas.description: A hilarious and lighthearted British reality competition that provides the same 'background comfort' as Gogglebox.

metas.name: The Orville
metas.description: A sci-fi comedy-drama that serves as a spiritual successor to classic Trek, matching the tone of Futurama.

metas.name: Abbott Elementary
metas.description: A warm, funny mockumentary that captures the daily struggles of workers with the charm of New Girl.

metas.name: Star Trek: Lower Decks
metas.description: A high-energy animated sci-fi comedy that celebrates the genre while being as funny as Rick and Morty.

metas.name: Regular Show
metas.description: A surreal animated series about two friends that starts normal and goes wild, similar to the vibe of Futurama.

metas.name: The Venture Bros.
metas.description: A brilliant parody of action-adventure tropes with deep lore, perfect for fans of Rick and Morty and Fallout.

metas.name: Spaced
metas.description: A cult British comedy filled with pop-culture references and geek humor, much like Community.

metas.name: Flight of the Conchords
metas.description: A quirky musical comedy about two New Zealanders in New York, matching the unique tone of Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Derry Girls
metas.description: A high-energy, hilarious ensemble comedy with a strong regional identity similar to Brassic.

metas.name: Mythic Quest
metas.description: A workplace comedy set in a video game studio that mirrors the tech-industry satire of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Hacks
metas.description: Sharp, witty, and character-driven, this show offers a high-quality comedic experience similar to Ted Lasso.

metas.name: The Great
metas.description: A 'semi-historical' comedy with a dark sense of humor and high energy, appealing to fans of Fallout.

metas.name: Ghosts (UK)
metas.description: A heartwarming and funny ensemble comedy about a group of ghosts and a living couple, perfect for relaxing.

metas.name: Superstore
metas.description: An easy-to-watch workplace sitcom with a diverse cast that provides excellent background comfort like Scrubs.

metas.name: Happy Endings
metas.description: A fast-paced ensemble comedy about a group of friends that shares the chaotic energy of New Girl.

metas.name: Party Down
metas.description: A cynical yet hilarious look at a group of caterers in LA, perfect for fans of Silicon Valley and It's Always Sunny.

metas.name: Peacemaker
metas.description: A hilarious and action-packed sci-fi adventure that doesn't take itself too seriously, matching the fun of One Piece.

metas.name: Resident Alien
metas.description: A fish-out-of-water sci-fi comedy about an alien trying to blend in, appealing to fans of Futurama's humor.

metas.name: Solar Opposites
metas.description: From the co-creator of Rick and Morty, this animated series offers similar sci-fi absurdity and dark humor.

metas.name: Better Off Ted
metas.description: A brilliant but short-lived corporate satire that fans of Silicon Valley's dry wit will love.

metas.name: Veep
metas.description: A fast-talking, cynical political comedy that captures the mean-spirited hilarity of It's Always Sunny.

metas.name: Mob Psycho 100
metas.description: Created by the same author as One-Punch Man, it perfectly balances spectacular action with comedic heart.

metas.name: Curb Your Enthusiasm
metas.description: The master of cringe comedy; if you enjoyed the awkward social situations in Peep Show, this is a must-watch.

metas.name: Cougar Town
metas.description: Created by the same team as Scrubs, it evolves into a wonderfully lighthearted show about a group of friends.

metas.name: Kim's Convenience
metas.description: A charming and funny family sitcom that offers the same comfort and heart as Malcolm in the Middle.

metas.name: Our Flag Means Death
metas.description: A whimsical and heartwarming pirate adventure that captures the fun and camaraderie found in One Piece.

metas.name: Freaks and Geeks
metas.description: A cult classic coming-of-age comedy that perfectly captures the awkwardness of youth like Malcolm in the Middle.

metas.name: Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt
metas.description: An incredibly colorful and optimistic comedy with high-speed jokes, similar in tone to The Good Place.

metas.name: Toast of London
metas.description: A surreal British comedy starring Matt Berry, perfect for fans of the eccentric humor in Peep Show.

metas.name: Red Dwarf
metas.description: A classic British sci-fi sitcom about a group of losers in space, providing a similar vibe to Futurama.

metas.name: Stath Lets Flats
metas.description: A brilliantly awkward British comedy about an incompetent letting agent, appealing to fans of Peep Show.
